selections.comment: TWO B TANNED sprung a 25/1 shock here last week when managing to get to the front to make all despite a very wide berth. She looked as if he had done too much early given how freely she ran but the field never got to her and was able to keep going to record a three and a half length win. That was no fluke and from stall two today the task is made a fair bit simpler even if the opposition are now fully aware of the potent threat she represents. The five pound penalty is unlikely to stop her if in the same mood and while the pressure up top will be sterner, Joe Fanning can be trusted to get the fractions spot on and can steer her to another all the way victory. Mr Jetman has been placed on his last three starts and looks most likely to benefit if things go awry for the selection, while Panama City races off a lower turf mark than AW, and although he's achieved more on synthetics the difference is not that great and he can go close a handy berth in stall four

Ballsbridge made an inauspicious start to the season when trounced in a small field event despite being sent off favourite. He needs to bounce back but has left a stinker well behind on next run before in his short career. The conditions suit and he's feared if getting back on track

selections.comment: MISTER DAYDREAM made an encouragijng return to the fray off a nine month absence looking a possible winner 1f out before being swamped late. He should come on for that and is entitled to go very close under these conditions. He won't mind any rain. Freddy Robinson is a big danger. His sole Flat win came over course and distance and arrives on the back of a decent fourth here over 2f further (stiff 1m4f stretches his stamina). Bay Dream Believer has to be forgiven a bit more than some having failed to fire in four runs since a good second at Hamilton in September. However, her return run came over an inadequate mile here and this trip will suit much better. She'll need to raise her game but is just a pound higher than her last winning mark and has the form to take this if close to her peak

selections.comment: SALARIA is taken to land a weak affair having shown that this 10f trip is well within her compass and that the switch away from AW to turf holds no fears when beaten narrowly at Redcar in early April. There's surely a fair bit left to come and Ollie Pears's filly looks primed to go well fitted in first time cheekpieces. Precious Storm was just a neck behind the selection at Redcar and has a pound pull so there's unlikely to be much between the pair again but the selection is less exposed and can just get the better of the duel again. Darla's Secret has a chance on the pick of his novice form but still has a lot to prove over this kind of trip so Staffordshire is feared more. He was slightly disapointing on handicap bow last time but that was over 12f and the drop back to 10f should help. He's shown some worrying signs of temperament a few times but has the ability and should be bang there if the in-form Harry Davies can cajole him to a more determined effort
